original_hook: A woman speaks to the camera while balancing a large stone on her head.
original_trend_mechanic: Literal visual interpretation of a proverb
adaptation_idea: King Robert humorously balances a massive falling castle stone on his head while crying out for help. Players match hammer and stone tiles in gameplay to shatter the heavy boulder before he collapses.
royal_match_adaptation: King Robert humorously balances a massive falling castle stone on his head while crying out for help. Players match hammer and stone tiles in gameplay to shatter the heavy boulder before he collapses.
opening_hook: An elderly woman wearing a red scarf and glasses speaks to the camera with a rock balanced on her head.
problem: A sudden castle danger threatens King Robert.
player_intervention: Player solves a rapid match-3 move to rescue King Robert.
payoff: Danger is resolved and King Robert safely celebrates.
king_robert_role: Main character in danger, then rescued by player intervention.
visual_style: Bright polished stylized 3D mobile game ad aesthetic.
